kSPwMnbJgjQliamvY9cOlQ.zh: 哥斯大黎加疫情升溫,今年截至第32週累計報告772例確定病例,逾去(2025)年全年報告數(373例)之兩倍,疫情主要集中於聖荷西省(San José),占全國病例73%,病患以20-64歲族群為主,部分區域以男性為多。經調查尚未發現單一共同感染源,懷疑為人傳人或水質不良所導致,當局已加強衛教宣導,呼籲⺠ 眾應飲用煮沸後之飲用水。
kSPwMnbJgjQliamvY9cOlQ.en: Costa Rica's epidemic is rising: as of week 32 this year, 772 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, more than double the 373 cases reported for all of 2025. The outbreak is concentrated in San José Province, which accounts for 73% of national cases; patients are mainly aged 20–64, and in some areas males predominate. Investigation has not identified a single common source; person-to-person transmission or poor water quality is suspected. Authorities have strengthened health education and urge people to drink boiled water.

rqbcS4IHeGLUUAQ9wal6xw.zh: 哥斯大黎加今年迄今報告82例病例(48例確定病例),疫情集中於西北部地區。該國自2016-2025年皆未報告確定病例,其中2025 年報告8例疑病例,惟皆未確診。
rqbcS4IHeGLUUAQ9wal6xw.en: Costa Rica has reported 82 cases so far this year (48 confirmed), concentrated in the north-west of the country. The country reported no confirmed cases from 2016 to 2025; in 2025, 8 suspected cases were reported, but none were diagnosed.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

cvLz3QVVa2CvVwnzaBCBCw.zh: 澳洲西澳大利亞州(Western Australia)疫情上升,今年迄今累計 36例確定病例,已高於過去2年整年病例數(2025年28例、 2024年23例),迄無死亡病例,多數病例為本土感染,且為第二分支之 IIb子分支(Clade IIb)。另感染者已從GBMSM族群擴大至異性戀男女,當局已提供高風險群體免費接種兩劑疫苗。該國疫情上升,今年共報告166例,自2022年迄今累計報告1,973例。 哥斯大黎加報告今年第3例確定病例,為37歲男性,調查顯示與第2例病例具流病關聯。疫情自首都聖荷西省擴散至埃雷迪亞省 ,當局已啟動接觸者追蹤。目前該國今年報告之 3 例確定病例病況皆穩定(均為成年男性,年齡介於27- 52歲間)。去(2025)年累計報告5例,自2022年迄今累計報告235例確定病例,其中1例死亡。
cvLz3QVVa2CvVwnzaBCBCw.en: Mpox cases are rising in Western Australia. So far this year, 36 confirmed cases have been reported, which is higher than the full-year totals of the past two years (28 in 2025 and 23 in 2024). No deaths have been reported to date. Most cases are locally acquired infections of Clade IIb, a subclade of the second clade. Infections have also spread from gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM) to heterosexual men and women. Authorities are providing free two-dose vaccination to high-risk groups. Australia has reported 166 cases this year and 1,973 cumulative cases since 2022. In Costa Rica, the country has reported its third confirmed case this year, a 37-year-old man. Investigation shows an epidemiological link to the second case. The outbreak has spread from the capital province of San José to Heredia Province, and authorities have started contact tracing. The three confirmed cases reported this year are all in stable condition (all adult men aged 27 to 52 years). Costa Rica reported 5 cases last year and has reported 235 confirmed cases since 2022, including 1 death.

LyXPWVSwiwQ39O31PhNolw.zh: 哥斯大黎加首都聖荷西今年首度報告2例確定病例,分別為25及55 歲男性,近期均無旅遊史,且無流行病學關聯,感染源及病毒分支型別仍待釐清,當局已啟動接觸者追蹤。該國去(2025)年共報告5例,自2022年迄今累計報告234例確定病例,其中1例死亡。
LyXPWVSwiwQ39O31PhNolw.en: The capital, San José, of Costa Rica reported 2 confirmed cases this year for the first time, both men aged 25 and 55 years. Neither had recent travel history, and they have no epidemiological link. The source of infection and the virus lineage remain to be clarified, and authorities have started contact tracing. Costa Rica reported 5 cases last year, and 234 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively since 2022, including 1 death.

V1xuQdREiddNmKqJq9U2Aw.zh: 巴西今年迄今累計報告 38,000 餘例病例及 15 例死亡,其中,西部南馬托羅索州累計逾 2,000 例確診病例及 10 例死亡。 哥斯大黎加報告今年第 3 例病例,為居住於該國西北部瓜納卡斯特省45 歲外國籍男性,依據流行病學調查,個案於潛伏期入境,屬境外移入病例。 瓜地馬拉西南部聖馬可仕省卡塔里娜於 2 月底報告 1 例確診病例,該省鄰近之墨西哥恰帕斯州於今年亦有報告病例。該國另報告 4 例疑病例,分布於埃斯昆特拉、奇基穆拉、瓜地馬拉省。評估美洲各國疫情持續上升,泛美衛生組織持續發布流行病學警示。
V1xuQdREiddNmKqJq9U2Aw.en: Brazil has reported more than 38,000 cases and 15 deaths so far this year, including more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 10 deaths cumulatively in the western state of Mato Grosso do Sul. Costa Rica reported its third case this year, a 45-year-old foreign national man residing in Guanacaste Province in the northwest of the country. Epidemiological investigation shows he entered the country during the incubation period, making it an imported case. In Catarina, San Marcos Department in the southwest of Guatemala, one confirmed case was reported at the end of February; the neighbouring Mexican state of Chiapas has also reported cases this year. Guatemala has also reported four suspected cases in Escuintla, Chiquimula and Guatemala departments. Given continued rises in case numbers across the Americas, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) continues to issue epidemiological alerts.

xG79CRPRwknlxzv7O-AQYQ.zh: 蘇利南疫情持續,1月份累計報告137例病例,美國CDC近期提升該國疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 哥斯大黎加報告今年第2例確診病例,為該國西部旁塔雷納斯省埃斯帕爾薩郡51歲女性,依症狀出現日期評估,個案感染日期可能與首例病例相近。
xG79CRPRwknlxzv7O-AQYQ.en: Suriname's outbreak continues: 137 cases were reported in January, and the US CDC recently raised its travel notice for the country to Level 2. Costa Rica reported its second confirmed case this year, a 51-year-old woman from Esparza District in Puntarenas Province in the west of the country. Based on the date of symptom onset, the infection date may be close to that of the first case.

LpUDgkb0MtG4iyWDrc5bEw.zh: 哥斯大黎加報告自2017年以來首例病例,為該國西部旁塔雷納斯省24歲男性居民,當局積極進行流行病學監測及病媒蚊控制,預防疾病傳播。outbreaknewstoday 1/25 蘇利南發生疫情,已報告8例病例,皆無國外旅遊史,目前正進行接觸者追蹤調查,並加強監測措施,避免疫情擴散。outbreaknewstoday 1/23 巴西西部馬托羅索州之盧卡斯市(Lucas do Rio Verde),於2025年報告1,769例病例(808例陽性),明顯高於2024年11例報告病例(9例陽性),並發現當地大部分埃及斑蚊孳生地都於住宅內,當局對此已採取相關防治措施。
LpUDgkb0MtG4iyWDrc5bEw.en: Costa Rica reported its first case since 2017: a 24-year-old male resident of Puntarenas province in the west. Authorities are carrying out active epidemiological surveillance and vector mosquito control to prevent transmission (source: Outbreak News Today, 25 January). Suriname has an outbreak with 8 reported cases, none with recent travel abroad. Contact tracing is under way, and surveillance has been strengthened to prevent spread (Outbreak News Today, 23 January). In Lucas do Rio Verde in Mato Grosso state, western Brazil, 1,769 cases (808 positive) were reported in 2025, markedly higher than the 11 cases (9 positive) reported in 2024. Most local Aedes aegypti breeding sites were found inside homes, and authorities have taken control measures.

Oojk9Z_tkTBNje6N3ECG9w.zh: 美國CDC於5/15報告1起與洞穴旅遊相關案例,來自同一家庭之12名病患於去(2024)年12月下旬前往哥斯大黎加北部一處洞穴旅遊,回國後出現頭痛、發燒、呼吸道及腸胃道等症狀,初期因未詢問旅遊史,導致誤診。其後採檢4名成員進行真菌抗原檢測,其中2名莢膜組織漿菌陽性,開始抗真菌藥物治療,目前均已康復。該處洞穴於1998-99年亦曾爆發組織漿菌症疫情,與蝙蝠糞便相關,故懷疑為此事件可能感染源,哥國已將此地點列入旅遊排除名單,美國亦發布旅遊警示,提醒民眾洞穴旅遊感染風險。
Oojk9Z_tkTBNje6N3ECG9w.en: The US CDC reported on 15 May one case linked to cave tourism. Twelve patients from the same family had visited a cave in northern Costa Rica in late December 2024. After returning home they developed headache, fever, and respiratory and gastrointestinal symptoms. The illness was initially misdiagnosed because their travel history was not asked about. Four family members were then tested with fungal antigen testing, and 2 of them were positive for Histoplasma capsulatum; antifungal treatment was started, and all have now recovered. The cave also had a histoplasmosis outbreak in 1998–99 linked to bat droppings, so it is suspected to be a possible source of this infection. Costa Rica has placed the site on its tourism exclusion list, and the United States has issued a travel alert reminding travelers of the infection risk from cave tourism.

MtnoDj3DtXCdMWVpRQnxxA.zh: 中南美洲近年病例數上升,巴拿馬/哥斯大黎加/加拉瓜/宏都拉斯/瓜地馬拉/薩爾瓦多/墨西哥等國均有人類感染病例。另加拿大於今年3月報告1例80歲男性病例,具哥斯大黎加旅遊史,顯示其可能透過國際旅遊傳播,增加國際傳播風險。螺旋蠅為寄生性蠅類,其幼蟲可寄生於人類及動物之傷口或天然腔道,造成「蠅蛆症」,目前無疫苗或特效藥物。
MtnoDj3DtXCdMWVpRQnxxA.en: Human infections have increased in Central and South America in recent years, with human cases reported in Panama, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Mexico and other countries. In addition, Canada reported a case in an 80-year-old man in March this year who had a travel history to Costa Rica, indicating that the disease may spread through international travel and increase the risk of international transmission. The screwworm fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae can parasitize wounds or natural body cavities of humans and animals, causing myiasis. There is currently no vaccine or specific drug.

iP-rGd0LeS2fA4ysumv0sw.zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,今年截至12/21累計報告10萬餘例病例,561例死亡,其中,約60%病例發生於10及11月份,並以男性病例為多;該國去年全年病例數達32萬餘例。 哥斯大黎加疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告3萬餘例病例,高於去年同期的2.8萬餘例,病例集中於該國中南部地區。
iP-rGd0LeS2fA4ysumv0sw.en: Bangladesh epidemic update: In 2024, up to 21 December, over 100,000 cases had been reported cumulatively, with 561 deaths. About 60% of cases occurred in October and November, and male cases predominate. Bangladesh recorded over 320,000 cases in 2023 as a whole. Costa Rica epidemic update: So far in 2024, over 30,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, higher than the over 28,000 cases in the same period of 2023. Cases are concentrated in the central and southern parts of the country.

j9yITXBZDQMc4zAovYGszw.zh: 哥斯大黎加疫情更新,今年截至10月底累計27,791例病例,較去年同期18,125例增加逾5成,病例主要分布於首都聖荷西(3,369例),另已報告5例死亡病例。
j9yITXBZDQMc4zAovYGszw.en: Costa Rica update: As of late October this year, 27,791 cases have been cumulatively reported, an increase of more than 50% over the same period last year (18,125 cases). Cases are mainly distributed in the capital, San José (3,369 cases). A total of 5 deaths have also been reported.
